description: Comparative Study of Numerical Models for Dynamic Analysis of Seismically Isolated Structures with High Damping Rubber Bearings is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Jose Gallardo, Pontifical Catholic University of Chile (uc.cl). Seismic isolation has gained popularity due to its effectiveness in protecting buildings and their contents during earthquakes. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: Seismic isolation; High damping rubber bearing; Model comparison; Performance assessment; Nonlinear response history, Uncertainty quantification. Published 2024-10-17. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
